references.matching_note: A map of Stacks-style commutative unital rings uses unit-preserving algebra morphisms.
The localization point is a prime ideal in the target commutative unital ring.
S_g is localization by the multiplicative set generated by the element g.
The local condition is that the localized ring map has the separately defined unramified property.

references.disposition: An element g outside an ideal is simply a set nonmembership condition on the ring underlying set.

review_rationale: Examined the entire localization-at-q definition, reusing the already indexed unramified ring-map property, prime ideals and ring localization, with a justified elementary nonmembership condition.
